* Produce weekly Management Information
* Work on adhoc projects required by Front office/Credit Officers of different regions and other global projects for e.g. the development \& maintenance of scorecards, process enhancements, automation etc.
* Build data processes and implement models in Python/ Alteryx to minimize manual effort and enable analysts to effectively and efficiently manage their portfolios.
* Contribute to the firm’s Risk Change agenda and participate in regulatory and audit assessments.
  

**Requirements:**  

  

**Mandatory**  

* CA Fresher/PGDM/MBA (Finance)/1\-3 years of prior experience in Credit Risk Analysis or Credit Reporting or part of techno functional roles in the credit risk domain.
* Strong analytical skills, including data analysis and technological skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, ability to present at Committees and lead Discussion Forums.
* Delivery focussed with the ability to work well under pressure and meet deadlines under compressed timescales.
* Attention to detail, ability to understand the big picture and act accordingly.
* The ability to be a “self\-starter”, working without supervision and managing multiple stakeholder expectations.

* **Organizational Tools:** Comfortable using basic project management tools like Trello, ClickUp, or Google Calendar to manage tasks and timelines.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations**

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support**

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.

* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.

* Protect company assets and customer property.

title: Job for Agniveers
description:
**Job Overview**

**\# ONLY AGNIVEERS SHOULD APPLY.**

Fourth Command is looking for a GRC Consultant to join its team in a full\-time role focused on governance, risk, and compliance activities. This position is ideal for a fresher or early\-career candidate who wants to build a career in cybersecurity with practical exposure to GRC platform management, risk assessment, standards mapping, workflow support, API integration coordination, and security documentation.

The selected candidate will support day\-to\-day GRC operations by helping manage platform activities, organizing compliance and risk\-related information, assisting in workflow configuration, supporting documentation, and working with internal stakeholders on security and governance requirements. GRC roles commonly act as the bridge between business processes and security requirements by helping organizations manage risk, maintain compliance, and improve governance practices.

This role is best suited for someone who has a strong interest in cybersecurity governance, attention to detail, and the willingness to learn how security standards, policies, controls, and technology platforms work together in an organizational environment. The role also requires a basic technical mindset, including familiarity with coding concepts and support for platform\-related integrations and process automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the day\-to\-day management and administration of GRC platforms, including maintaining records, updating entries, supporting modules, and helping users navigate platform\-related tasks.
* Assist in conducting risk assessments by identifying risks, documenting observations, tracking remediation items, and supporting the preparation of risk registers and related reports.
* Help map security controls, policies, and internal processes against applicable cybersecurity standards and frameworks.
* Support the documentation and maintenance of major global cybersecurity standards and compliance requirements relevant to the organization, such as:
* ISO/IEC 27001
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF)
* SOC 2
* PCI DSS
* GDPR
* HIPAA
* CIS Controls
* Assist with API integration\-related coordination for GRC or related platforms by supporting technical discussions, documenting integration requirements, validating data flow expectations, and working with technical teams where needed.
* Support workflow creation, updates, testing, and monitoring within the platform to improve process efficiency and task tracking.
* Provide platform support to internal users by helping troubleshoot basic issues, following up on platform tasks, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day usage.
* Prepare, maintain, and organize GRC\-related documentation, including policies, procedures, process notes, evidence records, user guides, control documentation, and audit support material.
* Assist with audit and assessment readiness activities by organizing evidence, maintaining repositories, and supporting follow\-up actions on observations and findings.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure risks, controls, workflow requirements, and documentation needs are properly tracked and updated.
* Support ongoing improvement of governance and compliance processes through structured reporting, documentation quality, and process discipline.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Fresher candidates can apply.
* Bachelor’s degree required in:
* BSc (IT)
* BSc (Cyber Security)
* BSc (Computer Science)
* BCA
* Candidate must have a minimum academic qualification of above 7\.0 CGPA in their qualifying degree.
* Good understanding or academic exposure to cybersecurity, information security, governance, risk, or compliance concepts is preferred.
* Basic awareness of major global cybersecurity standards and frameworks is required, especially ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR, HIPAA, and CIS Controls.
* Understanding of risk assessment concepts, control documentation, and process\-based security work is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of GRC platforms, compliance tools, ticketing systems, or workflow\-based platforms will be an advantage.
* Basic coding knowledge is required, with familiarity in technologies such as Python, React, Node.js, or similar tools useful for platform support, automation, integrations, and technical coordination.
* Understanding of APIs, system integration basics, and data flow concepts will be beneficial for this role.
* Good documentation skills are essential, as the role involves preparing and maintaining process documents, policies, records, and support material.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills are important for working with internal teams and supporting compliance\-related coordination.
* Good analytical thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to learn are important for success in a GRC\-focused role.

**Working Model**

This is a full\-time role with Fourth Command and is suitable for candidates who are comfortable working in a structured professional environment with process\-driven responsibilities. The role may involve regular coordination with internal stakeholders, platform users, technical teams, and compliance\-related functions.

The position is best suited for candidates who are interested in long\-term growth in cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance operations, and platform\-based security process management. Consistency, discipline, and comfort with documentation\-heavy and process\-oriented work will be important in this role.

**Mindset and Commitment**

Fourth Command is looking for a candidate who is sincere, detail\-oriented, and genuinely interested in building a career in cybersecurity with a governance and risk focus. Since this is a junior role, the company will value learning attitude, accountability, and willingness to work patiently on structured tasks such as documentation, risk tracking, platform updates, and workflow support.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, organized, and capable of balancing technical understanding with process discipline. A strong sense of ownership, professional communication, and readiness to learn both business and security requirements will be important for long\-term success in this role.

This position is well suited for someone who wants to grow in the GRC domain by gaining hands\-on exposure to cybersecurity standards, risk assessment, platform management, workflow support, integrations, and security documentation in a professional consulting environment.

description:
**About TPSTECH**

TPSTECH (tpstech.in) is one of India's most trusted IT hardware stores, and we're building it into India's first true IT Store, where a customer can buy anything from a mouse to a multi\-GPU AI server, and get genuine products with expert support. Since 2014 we've fulfilled 15,00,000\+ orders across 10,000\+ products, hold a 4\.6★ rating from 1,000\+ Google reviews. Unlike a faceless marketplace, our support is human, proactive and trusted, and we're growing the team that delivers it.

**About the role**

You'll be the human voice customers reach when they're spending anywhere from a few hundred to a few lakh rupees on hardware. Across phone, WhatsApp, email and chat, you'll help them pick the right part, resolve orders and deliveries, handle returns and warranty claims, and follow every issue through to a clean close. Our customers know their hardware, this is a technical, real\-time role for someone mature and capable, not a script\-reading BPO seat.

**What you'll do**

* Support customers across **phone, WhatsApp, email and chat**, promptly, accurately and with genuine care
* Help customers choose the **right, compatible product** (the correct laptop battery/charger, the right RAM, NAS drive or GPU), often proactively confirming compatibility before an order ships
* Own orders, delivery, returns, replacements, \& RMA
* Learn our range well enough to answer real questions on storage, NAS, networking, components, monitors, GPUs and servers, full product training provided.
* Support **business (B2B) orders**: GST invoicing, high\-value orders, in coordination with the team
* Track every ticket and close it within our service timelines; escalate complex cases through the right channel
* Coordinate with catalogue, shipping and vendor teams to get issues resolved
* Keep accurate records and daily trackers.
* Uphold the trust and authenticity that TPSTECH is known for, on every single interaction

**What we're looking for**

* **1–2 years of hands\-on customer support experience, including a voice process** — you've handled live customers and stay calm, mature and accountable when someone is frustrated
* A **technically curious** mind — comfortable with computers and genuinely eager to learn IT hardware in depth, from a mouse to a multi\-GPU server
* Clear, confident **English and Hindi**, written and spoken
* **Working knowledge of MS Excel** — formulas, sorting, filtering (VLOOKUP/COUNTIF a plus)
* Mature, responsible and organised — takes ownership without being chased
* Based in (or willing to relocate to) **Lucknow**, and looking for a **stable, long\-term** role

**Nice to have**

* Support experience in e\-commerce, IT hardware, electronics or a technology company
* A personal interest in PC building, NAS, networking or AI/servers
* Familiarity with helpdesk/ticketing tools, Shopify or WhatsApp Business
* Exposure to B2B/GST order handling

**Please don't apply if…**

✕ You have no prior customer support experience — this isn't a trainee or fresher role

✕ You're not comfortable speaking with customers on calls

✕ You avoid technology or aren't interested in learning technical products in depth

✕ You're looking for a short\-term, stop\-gap or work\-from\-home\-only role

✕ You can't work on\-site in Lucknow, full\-time

✕ Your spoken or written English/Hindi isn't strong, clear communication is the heart of this job

**What you'll get**

* A role at one of India's top IT hardware stores, working with everything from peripherals to cutting\-edge AI/server hardware
* Deep product training and a real path to grow into **senior support, technical pre\-sales or operations**
* A close\-knit, ambitious team where your work is visible and valued.

**Mibo, The Mind Expert** \| **Bengaluru** (on\-site) \| Full\-time

**When someone finally finds the courage to ask for help, you are the first voice they hear.**

Most people in India struggle silently for years before they make one phone call about their mental health. When that call finally comes to Mibo, you are the one who answers it.

You listen. You understand. You guide them to the right psychiatrist or psychologist. A call that took them years to make becomes their first real step toward getting better, because of how you handled it.

***This is not just a call centre job. This is healthcare, and it begins with you.***

**What your day looks like**

* You answer first calls and WhatsApp messages from people looking for help
* You listen with patience, understand what is really going on, and guide them to the right expert
* You book consultations and help worried families take that first step
* You support our doctors whenever a caller needs urgent help

**Why you will love this work**

* Full clinical training with certification, covering crisis handling, care routing and communication skills
* You work with psychiatrists and psychologists every single day and learn from them
* A clear path to grow into psychiatric social work roles in our hospital
* We look after your mind too, with free and confidential support from our own team
* You see your impact with your own eyes. Someone gets better because you picked up the phone.

**You will fit right in if you**

* Hold an MSW or a Psychology degree. Freshers are welcome, and your fieldwork counts.
* Stay calm and kind when someone on the line is upset or in tears
* Speak English and Kannada. Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil or Telugu is a lovely bonus.
* Believe, like we do, that helping someone reach care is itself social work

**How to apply**  
Send your CV to hr@mibocare.com along with five simple lines answering this one question: *"Tell us about a time you helped someone who was struggling."*

We read every single answer, and the ones that move us get called first.

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
**Work Type:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Dadar)
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1–3 Years
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're building learning\-based control for diverse robotic systems, aimed at real\-world deployment in industrial setups. We pair classical robotics \- kinematics, dynamics, perception, navigation, control \- with modern vision\-language\-action (VLA) models, and we care as much about what happens on real hardware as in simulation.
   

  

 You'll join a small, technically dense team where your work ships to physical robots quickly. If you like the space between "the model said to move here" and "the arm actually moved there, safely," this is that job.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Model and characterize robot manipulators: kinematics, dynamics, coordinate frames, calibration.
* Build and maintain robot models and simulation environments, and keep sim behavior faithful to the real arms.
* Bring up hardware: servo/motor control, sensor integration, teleoperation and data\-collection rigs.
* Work at the boundary between classical control and learned policies \- turning a policy's output into safe, reliable motion on hardware.
* Creation of data flywheel for model fine\-tuning for multiple tasks and embodiments
* Set up evaluation: reproducible benchmarks in sim and on the robot, with honest metrics.
* Debug the messy real\-world failures that never show up in a paper.


**What We're Looking For**
* 1–3 years of hands\-on robotics experience (industry, research lab, or a serious body of personal/open\-source work).
* Strong grounding in classical robotics: forward/inverse kinematics, rigid\-body dynamics, trajectory generation, feedback control, transforms.
* Experience with robot modeling (e.g. URDF / MJCF / SDF) and at least one physics simulator (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim/Gym, Gazebo, PyBullet, or similar).
* Proficient in Python and C\+\+.
* Comfortable on Linux, with Git, and working close to hardware.
* Clear communicator who can reason from first principles and validate claims against real data or source code rather than intuition alone.


**Nice To Have (a Plus, Not Required)**
* A portfolio of robotics work \- repos, demos, videos, publications, competition entries, or a personal project we can look at.
* Exposure to learning\-based robotics: imitation learning, VLA models, or RL for control.
* Hands\-on time with real manipulators and grippers.
* Perception experience (depth cameras, point clouds, hand\-eye calibration).
* Background in optimization or optimal control.
* Familiarity with the LeRobot / OpenVLA ecosystem.


**Why join**
* Real robots, real deployment targets, short loop from idea to hardware.
* A team strong in controls, safety, and systems \- you'll learn fast.

**Job Description**
**The Future Begins Here**

 Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center.  Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Business Analyst in the Donor Information System (DIS) space within the Plasma\-Derived Therapies (PDT) business unit, you will independently serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams. You will collaborate closely with multiple stakeholders, determine requirements, translate business needs into effective technical solutions, maintaining continuous dialogue with all teams to ensure robustness, accuracy and consistency.
   

  

 By gathering requirements and facilitating cross\-team communication between business and IT teams, this role directly contributes to PDT’s ability to harness data effectively, enhancing decision\-making capabilities, and ultimately, competitive advantage in the market. You will be adopting cutting\-edge technologies and methodologies which will help Takeda drive innovation, adapt to new opportunities, and continuously evolve in an ever\-changing business/technological landscape.
   

  

 This position will align to Functional Analysis chapter of the ICC and initially report to the Functional Delivery Lead for strategic direction as well as day\-to\-day management until the role of BA Lead is filled within Takeda ICC, post which the reporting and managerial responsibilities will be transitioned accordingly.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
* Contribute to the execution team by proactively clarifying requirements, identifying gaps, and escalating risks.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Senior Business Analysts and product stakeholders to ensure functional expectations are understood and delivered.
* Act as a reliable communication link between developers, testers, Quality, and business SMEs.
* Lead requirement‑gathering discussions for low–to–moderately complex features, including understanding user needs, non‑functional requirements, and pain points.
* Analyze requirements and document them into clear, structured artifacts such as Epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflows.

* Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, and story grooming sessions
* Highlight/identify gaps in existing functionality/user requirements.
* Conduct gap analysis, process mapping, and impact assessments for new enhancements.
* Support and contribute to user acceptance testing (UAT) efforts, including test case development, test execution, issue resolution, and assist in triaging functional defects.
* Liaise with different stakeholders including the client/business owner, project manager, solution architect, developers, testers and validators to ensure timely delivery of items and alignment on system changes
* Understand the business justification for the product, client’s vision, and future scope.
* Create functional design documents and other documentation required as part of GxP documentation process and work closely with the Quality and Validation teams ensuring timely approvals are obtained.
* Ensure documentation remains audit‑ready, consistent, and aligned with development and Quality expectations.
* Maintain Confluence spaces with updated feature details, design notes, and process artifacts.
* Support test case preparation through creation of test scenarios and acceptance tests that align with documented requirements.
* Assist with UAT planning and coordinate with business users to validate feature readiness.
* Perform initial root‑cause assessment for functional issues by reviewing logs, data, and workflows.
* Work closely with developers and architects to define technical solutions and clarify requirements
* Use SQL queries to validate data behavior, troubleshoot inconsistencies, and verify system outputs.
* Partner with the validation team throughout the validation lifecycle to clarify functional requirements, address queries and drive timely resolution of validation findings and issues.
* Provide structured issue documentation for senior analysts and developers.
* Support creation of change rationale and impact assessments for changes within your scope.
* Ensure compliance with change control and validation requirements, especially for GxP systems.
* Collaborate extensively across the organization, keep abreast of industry trends, continuously learn and adapt to new tools and techniques, and contribute to process improvement efforts.


**Minimum Requirements/Qualifications**
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field is required
* 3\-5 years of experience working as Business Analyst/Product Owner, with a focus on gathering requirements and designing solutions.
* Hands\-on experience using
+ Jira

* Understanding of requirements, use cases, and specification for features

* Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools
* Expertise in Agile (incl. PI Planning, Roadmap Development, Backlog Prioritization etc) and product Mindset \& Analytical Skillset
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with stakeholders at all levels
* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodology and SDLCExperience in change management
* Self\-motivated, with the ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks effectively
* Highly organized; able to break down complex problems and set priorities
* Strong relationship building and team collaboration skills


**Preferred Requirements**
* Regulatory knowledge such as change control processes related to GXP systems including the ability to create and manage change controls to ensure compliance, GXP documentation process and experience in drafting detailed documentation for Verification and Validation cycle.
* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure)
* Familiarity with DevOps Practices (CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience with advanced prototyping tools such as Figma

* Hands\-on experience providing support for validation testing and resolving issues that arise during the process.
* Ability to query databases for relevant data requests and evaluations


**Benefits**

* Use Redis for caching, session management, and application performance improvements.
* Implement background jobs, queues, and asynchronous processing using BullMQ.
* Work with message brokers and event\-driven systems using RabbitMQ and/or Apache Kafka.
* Develop reliable producer\-consumer workflows and handle asynchronous communication between microservices.
* Integrate third\-party APIs and external services.
* Implement proper error handling, logging, validation, authentication, and authorization.
* Debug and troubleshoot application, database, queue, and API\-related issues.

* Microservices Architecture
* PostgreSQL
* Microsoft SQL Server (MS SQL)
* Redis
* RESTful API Development
* GraphQL API Development
* BullMQ
* RabbitMQ and/or Apache Kafka
* Understanding of message queues, producers, consumers, retries, and background job processing.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, Promises, and async/await.
* Good understanding of database design, relationships, joins, indexes, and SQL queries.
* Understanding of authentication and authorization concepts.
* Familiarity with Git and version\-control workflows.
* Basic understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile development practices.



  





 Preferred Skills
 


* Experience with frameworks such as Express.js, NestJS, or similar Node.js frameworks.
* Experience building event\-driven or queue\-based systems.
* Understanding of JWT or token\-based authentication.
* Familiarity with Docker and containerized applications.
* Basic knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman.
* Understanding of design patterns and clean architecture principles.
* Knowledge of unit and integration testing is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of message delivery concepts such as retries, acknowledgements, dead\-letter queues, and idempotency.



  





 Experience \& Qualifications
 


* 1–2 years of professional experience in backend or Node.js development.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Hands\-on experience developing backend APIs and working with databases.
* Exposure to message queues or event\-driven architecture is preferred.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.



  





 Ideal Candidate
 



 The ideal candidate is passionate about backend development and enjoys building scalable, high\-performance systems. They have a strong foundation in backend engineering, understand microservices, caching strategies, background job processing, and asynchronous messaging, and are committed to writing clean, maintainable, and production\-ready code. The candidate should be eager to learn, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and contribute to the development of innovative AI\-powered products.

**About Flexport:**
-------------------



At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.



The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

**About the role**
------------------



We're looking for an experienced HR Generalist, based in Mumbai, to own the full employee lifecycle and people programs across India and the Subcontinent. This is a true generalist role: you'll run recruiting end to end, manage onboarding through offboarding, and drive the HR operations, compliance, and employee\-experience work that keeps our teams thriving. You'll be the local face of the APAC People team, making sure our ambitious growth is supported by a robust and effective people strategy. We're building a People function that works smarter with AI, so you'll be encouraged to use modern AI\-powered tools to automate manual work, sharpen sourcing, and free up more time for the human side of HR.


**What You'll do**
------------------


* Own full\-cycle recruiting for a range of roles across departments—building search strategies, sourcing active and passive candidates, screening, interviewing, and guiding candidates through hiring and onboarding.
* Track sourcing data to focus effort on the channels with the highest ROI, and partner closely with hiring managers to attract, assess, and close top talent.
* Drive proactive recruiting initiatives and help build the Flexport employer brand across the region.
* Communicate candidate pipelines, funnel metrics, and performance data clearly and regularly to internal stakeholders.
* Serve as the local representative of the APAC People team, enhancing employee experience across the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding.
* Lead local HR operations including data management, employee support, reporting and analytics, process improvement, payroll support, and policy development.
* Maintain accurate HRIS data in Workday, run audits, and resolve employee tickets.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to automate repetitive HR tasks, source and screen candidates faster, and surface insights from people data.
* Act as the local expert on HR policy and ensure HR compliance across the region.
* Take on additional projects from the global and regional People leadership team as needed.

**What You'll bring**

title: HR Manager
description:
We are a growing multi\-business group based in Madurai employing over 300 people. We are looking for an experienced Chief HR Manager to own the complete HR function across all our business units.

This is a senior, independent role. You will report directly to management and will be responsible for building and running HR systems, ensuring statutory compliance, processing payroll, designing performance frameworks, and developing our workforce. We need someone who can operate with minimal supervision and takes full ownership.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Recruitment \& Onboarding:**

* End\-to\-end hiring across all business units — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding
* Design and maintain induction process and probation tracking for all new joiners

**Payroll \& Compensation:**

* Monthly payroll processing for 100\+ employees across all units
* Salary structure design, advance and loan tracking, and full and final settlement
* Coordinate with accounts team for disbursement and ledger entries

**Statutory Compliance:**

* ESI and PF — monthly challan, employee registration, and claim coordination
* Professional Tax, Gratuity, and Bonus compliance
* Labour law compliance — Factories Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Minimum Wages Act
* Maintain statutory registers and ensure readiness for labour inspections at all times

**KPI \& KRA Framework:**

* Design and implement KRA and KPI frameworks for every role across all businesses
* Conduct quarterly performance reviews and compile reports for management
* Manage performance improvement plans for underperforming employees

**Training \& Development:**

* Identify training needs and design quarterly training calendars
* Deliver induction training for new joiners and coordinate external programs
* Build and maintain a skills matrix for the entire workforce

**Employee Relations:**

* Handle grievances, disciplinary matters, and exit interviews
* Maintain a positive work culture and manage attrition proactively

**HR Reporting:**

* Monthly HR MIS report to management — headcount, compliance status, attrition, training
* Maintain all employee records digitally — contracts, documents, performance history

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Mandatory:**

* MBA (HR) / MSW / PGDHRM or equivalent qualification
* 7–12 years of HR experience with at least 4 years in a manufacturing or industrial environment
* Hands\-on payroll processing experience for 100\+ employee headcount
* Strong knowledge of ESI, PF, Factories Act, and Tamil Nadu labour laws
* Proven experience designing and implementing KRA and KPI frameworks
* Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong Tamil communication; working English for documentation

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience managing HR across multiple business units simultaneously
* Familiarity with HRMS software — Zoho People, GreytHR, or similar
* Training facilitation experience — ability to conduct sessions independently

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Senior leadership role with full ownership of the HR function
* Exposure to HR management across three distinct industries
* Direct reporting to and visibility with senior management
* Stable, long\-term employment with a well\-established business group
* Performance\-based salary revision annually

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease – we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Senior Associate, Talent Management, University Relations – Intern Program**

**What you will do**


Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will manage Amgen’s intern program end to end as part of the University Relations team, creating a structured, engaging, and high\-impact experience for interns from Day 1 onboarding through program completion and exit. You will partner closely with hiring managers, business leaders, Talent Acquisition, HR partners, and university stakeholders to ensure interns are aligned to meaningful projects, receive timely support, and experience Amgen’s mission, culture, and career opportunities in a compelling way.


You will play a key role in strengthening Amgen’s early talent pipeline by driving intern program operations, development experiences, bootcamps, evaluations, engagement activities, and employer branding initiatives such as intern testimonials and program success stories. This role requires strong program management, stakeholder partnership, communication, and execution discipline to deliver a consistent, inclusive, and impactful intern experience across functions.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Own the end\-to\-end intern program lifecycle, including onboarding, engagement, learning experiences, performance check\-ins, evaluations, conversion support, and exit activities.
* Partner with hiring managers to ensure interns are assigned relevant, well\-scoped, and business\-aligned projects that provide meaningful learning and measurable impact.
* Design and execute intern onboarding experiences that help interns understand Amgen’s mission, ways of working, expectations, resources, and support channels from Day 1\.
* Assess the health of the intern cohort through structured touchpoints, pulse checks, manager feedback, intern evaluations, and program metrics.
* Plan, coordinate, and run intern bootcamps, learning sessions, speaker series, networking events, project showcases, and engagement forums.
* Drive intern communication rhythm, including program calendars, milestone updates, manager guidance, intern reminders, feedback timelines, and closing communications.
* Work with managers and HR partners to identify and resolve intern experience risks, project misalignment, engagement concerns, or performance\-related issues in a timely manner.
* Lead intern performance and evaluation processes, ensuring feedback is collected, documented, reviewed, and used to support development and potential conversion decisions.
* Build and execute intern branding initiatives, including intern testimonials, project spotlights, success stories, campus\-facing content, and internal storytelling.
* Partner with University Relations and Talent Acquisition teams to align intern program activities with campus hiring, employer branding, and early talent strategy.
* Track intern program data, feedback, participation, satisfaction, project outcomes, and conversion indicators to identify insights and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Create and maintain program playbooks, onboarding materials, manager guides, evaluation templates, communication plans, and process documentation.
* Support intern exit processes, including final presentations, feedback capture, knowledge transition, offboarding coordination, and alumni engagement opportunities.

**What we expect of you**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

**Basic Qualifications:**


Master's degree / Bachelor's degree and 5 to 9 years of experience in Human Resources, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, University Relations, Program Management, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field

**Must\-Have Skills**

* Prior experience designing and managing internship, early talent, university relations, talent management, or campus programs end to end.
* Experience managing the pre\-placement offer process, including intern evaluation outcomes, stakeholder alignment, offer recommendations, communication, and conversion tracking.
* Strong program management skills with the ability to manage timelines, stakeholders, events, communications, risks, and deliverables across multiple workstreams.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with hiring managers and business leaders to define meaningful intern projects, clarify expectations, and drive accountability.
* Experience designing and executing onboarding, bootcamps, learning sessions, engagement events, evaluations, or development programs.

A center of expertise and innovation, this hub is now home to over **900\+ talented colleagues** working across Customer Service Operations, Data and Technology, Finance Operations, HR Operations, Procurement Operations, and other key enabling functions.


We are committed to crafting impactful solutions for all our brands and divisions to power Flutter's incredible growth and global impact. With the scale of a leader and the mindset of a challenger, we’re dedicated to creating a brighter future for our customers, colleagues, and communities.


**Role Summary**

An exciting opportunity exists to join Flutter’s Internal Controls Assurance team. We are seeking to hire a talented Internal Controls Senior Manager to join the team. The ideal candidates will have experience working in a Business Controls function for a major multinational company or audit firm. The Flutter Internal Controls team is a key part of our governance framework and an important component of the second line of defense. A key Group\-wide function, it is responsible for promoting high standards of internal controls to reduce financial risk, delivering the annual internal controls testing plan, and providing guidance to the business on what robust controls look like. The roles involve providing an independent opinion on the design adequacy of the control framework and providing objective assurance to confirm that the controls are operating as expected.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Audit Planning \& Execution:


* Planning and execution of internal controls testing plan under the guidance of Business Controls Assurance Lead in accordance with defined quality standards and deadlines.
* Liaising with external auditors as required.

Team Management:


* Managing the team of Analyst, Senior Auditors and Audit Managers, ensuring their work is completed on time and supporting with any queries.
* Performing review of the testing performed by the team and providing guidance as required.
* Identification of skill gaps within the team and running formal/ informal trainings to upskill the team members.

Stakeholder Management:


* Identifying and communicating Business control deficiencies to management along with monitoring of management’s responses as well as implementation of agreed remediation plans.
* Continuously communicating with Internal Controls Senior Management on the progress to plan.
* Working with the Internal Controls Lead, internal controls colleagues including transformation and Finance / Business Heads, to improve internal control environment.
* Collaborate with the teams of other key internal stakeholders who have ownership of the processes to be tested, to deliver the Internal Controls plan and address concerns they may have.

**EXCEL IN THIS ROLE YOU NEED TO HAVE**

* Qualified accountant (ACA, CPA, ACCA, or CIMA)
* PCAOB audit experience of 10 to 12 years and experience in a professional services or industry role.
* Experience delivering ICFR activities day\-to\-day, across at least one whole financial year cycle.
* Experience of navigating material weakness or significant deficiency of remediation is advantageous, but not essential.
* Some experience of significant finance transformation activities in ICFR or with ICFR impacts, such as a GRC implementation, global process owner deployment, an ERP implementation, or technology enablement of the annual ICFR cycle, is advantageous, but not essential.
* Experience of betting, gaming or online entertainment businesses is advantageous, but not essential.
* Experience of Oracle ERP and related Oracle systems is advantageous, but not essential.
* Delivering the Internal Controls testing and assessments on time.
* Achieving an unqualified ICFR opinion from the external auditors for the year ended 31 December 2025\.
* Maintaining an unqualified ICFR opinion from the external auditors across the period of finance transformation, most significantly in 2026 and 2027\.
* Building the foundations for a culture where ICFR is seen as a critical part of the Group’s external financial reporting, and where roles contributing to ICFR are seen to be excellent progression opportunities into more senior finance roles.
* Good project management and organisation skills, to be able to manage the delivery of one or several workstreams to short\-term and long\-term deadlines.
* Good management skills, for directing the day\-to\-day activities of the internal and external support.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, to be able to clearly articulate the status of work and the risks that may cause timetable or cost challenges.

title: Global Payroll Specialist - Europe and Africa
description:
Envoy Global is a proven innovator in the global immigration space. Our mission combines our industry\-leading tech platform with holistic service to streamline, simplify and expedite the immigration process for employers and individuals.



We now have an exciting opportunity within Envoy Global's Human Resources team for an experienced **Payroll Specialist** to join us on a full‑time basis. This role is integral to ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll operations across multiple international regions including the **UK, Europe, and Africa**.



As a key member of the HR function, the Payroll Specialist will manage end‑to‑end payroll processing, maintain and analyze confidential payroll data, and serve as a primary payroll resource for employees across multiple countries. This position will work closely with our Payroll Manager, Country Managers, HRIS teams, and external vendors to ensure flawless payroll execution, adherence to country‑specific regulations, and exceptional employee support. The individual will also play a vital role in driving process accuracy, maintaining statutory compliance, and supporting key finance and HR initiatives across the organization.



**As our Payroll Specialist, you will be required to:**


* Monthly end to end payroll processing for UK, Germany, Kenya, Namibia and South Africa.
* Review and prepare multi country payroll monthly for hourly and salaried employees in accordance with Country, regional, and local laws, and standard accounting principles.
* Expertise\[JS2\.1]\[JS3\.1]\[JS4\.1] in handling multicurrency payroll for UK, European and African countries and exchange rates where applicable.
* Support our Payroll Manager with global payroll processes
* Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations. Process PAYE, NIC, student loans. Administer statutory payments. Year\-end activities P69,P11D,P45's
* Ensure compliance with local tax authorities in Africa, Manage local statutory deductions, pension funds, NHIF/medical schemes
* Maintain \& audit current payroll system for time \& attendance, employee records, etc. in preparation of payroll processing
* Partner with country managers and business HRs in the country to ensure all timekeeping tasks are completed, and support troubleshooting system issues
* Process voluntary deductions, garnishments, child support orders, tax levies, quarterly tax verifications, in accordance with all relevant laws
* Support tax\-related reconciliations
* Partner with HRIS, local vendors, tax authorities and payroll providers, where appropriate, to ensure payroll tax payment deadlines and compliance requirements are met in all jurisdictions
* Answer employee questions related to time and attendance, paychecks, deductions, and taxes
* Support Finance and HR teams with special projects and reports as required
* Region specific duties:  

 UK: Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations, processing PAYE, NIC, student loans, statutory payments and year\-end tax related activities  

 Africa: ensuring compliance with local tax authorities including but not limited to SARS, KRA, FIRS, ZIMRA, URA etc) as well as managing local statutory deductions such as PAYE, Social Security, Pension Funds, NHIF/Medical Schemes.
  


**To apply for this role, you should possess the following skills, experience and qualifications:**


* Working knowledge of the Country specific taxation, statutory and benefit related wage and hour legislation
* Experienced in MS Excel including V\-Lookups, Pivot Tables
* Experience with processing global payroll and liaison with vendors
* Ability to navigate through and learn HRIS/payroll systems quickly
* CPP or similar credentials preferred
* Able to work across time zones
* 3 to 6 years of experience processing payroll for a multi\-national employer, demonstrating knowledge of country specific payroll tax regulations, specifically experience in the UK, Germany and South Africa is a requirement.
* Graduation or above


***If this role excites you, please take a moment to complete the questionnaire below and attach your current resume. We look forward to your prompt response.***

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

**Job Summary:**


GCC Vadodara campus seeks to hire Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) / LCA Analyst who can contribute to the growth of Xylem's Global Capability Center and its expansion into sustainable technology and business solutions. The selected candidate will be responsible for conducting life cycle assessments for our global product development teams. If you are excited and passionate, we want to hear from you!

**Principal Responsibilities:**

* Support Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) studies through data collection, modeling, and analysis.
* Collect, organize, and maintain product, manufacturing, and environmental data.
* Assist in preparing LCA reports, Product Sustainability Reports (PSRs) and Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs).
* Work with cross\-functional teams to gather products and process information.
* Learn and use LCA software tools such as SimaPro or equivalent.
* Ensure data accuracy, documentation and compliance with internal quality standards.
* Stay updated on sustainability standards, LCA methodologies and industry best practices

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Environmental, Chemical, Industrial, Production Engineering or a related discipline.
* 0–1 year of experience (Freshers are encouraged to apply).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Eagerness to learn sustainability concepts and environmental assessment tools.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Basic understanding of sustainability, carbon footprint or Life Cycle Assessment concepts.
* Familiarity with ISO 14040/14044 or Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) is an advantage.
* Exposure to LCA software (SimaPro, GaBi, OpenLCA, or One Click LCA) through academic projects or internships is desirable.
* Knowledge of product design and development.
* Knowledge of manufacturing industry process.
* Adaptability to work with different work cultures and time zones.

**What You’ll Gain:**

* Hands\-on experience in industrial Life Cycle Assessment.
* Exposure to global sustainability projects and product development.
* Training on LCA software, international standards and EPD development.
* Opportunity to work with global engineering and sustainability teams.
* A structured learning path toward becoming an LCA and Product Sustainability professional.


Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

description:
**Content Writer**

**The Role \-** 

Most content roles end at the Google Doc. This one does not.

At Cidroy, you'll own the company's organic growth engine, from strategy and writing to rankings, AI visibility, and business impact. Success is measured by traffic, leads, and whether AI models cite us when buyers ask questions in our category.

We build mission\-critical software for high\-security, industrial, and enterprise environments where accuracy matters. Explaining complex technical products clearly, while making them discoverable through search and AI, is the core challenge.

You will own the company's content roadmap across every organic channel. You'll decide what gets created, what gets updated, and what gets removed based on performance.

**Who Should Apply \-**

Experience is not the deciding factor here.

If you can demonstrate exceptional writing, strong SEO execution, and the ability to own outcomes, we want to hear from you. Freshers who genuinely meet the expectations of this role are encouraged to apply alongside experienced candidates.

**What You'll Own \-** 

* Content strategy across the website, blog, product pages, documentation, case studies, and comparison pages
* Clear, technically accurate writing for technical buyers
* Brand voice across every content surface
* Content audits, refreshes, and pruning low\-performing pages
* Keyword research, search intent mapping, and content briefs
* On\-page SEO including metadata, internal linking, schema, and content structure
* Identifying technical SEO issues and working with developers to resolve them
* GEO and AEO through AI\-friendly content structure, entity clarity, FAQs, and schema
* Search Console health including indexing, sitemaps, canonicals, and coverage issues
* Performance reporting across GA4, Search Console, and social analytics
* LinkedIn, newsletter, and content repurposing across channels
* Community engagement where the audience already exists
* Prioritizing future content investments based on data

**Must Have \-** 

**Writing**

* A portfolio that demonstrates clear, high\-quality writing
* Ability to explain technical subjects accurately for an audience that includes engineers

**SEO**

* Hands\-on experience driving measurable SEO outcomes, whether professionally or through your own projects
* Strong understanding of on\-page SEO and enough technical SEO knowledge to identify problems and brief a developer

**Operating Style**

* Evidence that you own outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks
* Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly
* Ability to work independently without needing constant direction

**Good to Have \-** 

* Effective use of AI tools for research, drafting, repurposing, and automation while keeping the writing genuinely human
* Experience with CMS platforms, Markdown, HTML, and Git
* Basic design skills using Figma, Canva, or similar
* Startup experience or personal projects
* Experience growing a content channel, website, or audience from scratch

**What Strong Looks Like \-** 

* You read about a product or feature and come back with a content strategy, not a list of questions
* You can connect published content to measurable traffic, ranking, or business outcomes
* You remove content that no longer performs because the data supports the decision
* You turn one piece of research into multiple high\-quality content formats without repeating yourself
* You decide what should be prioritized next and can defend it with data

**This Role Is Not For \-** 

* Writers who only hand content off for others to publish or optimize
* Candidates who describe SEO in terms of tools instead of outcomes
* People who need a content calendar handed to them instead of building one
* Writers looking for a narrowly scoped execution role without ownership

**Why Cidroy \-** 

Cidroy builds software for defence\-adjacent, industrial, and enterprise environments where reliability is critical. You'll work directly with a technical founding team in a fast\-moving environment with real ownership, short feedback loops, and meaningful impact.

**How to Apply \-** 

Complete the screening form below to apply. It is a mandatory part of the application process, and applications without a completed form will not be considered.

**Screening Form:** ***https://forms.gle/Vyi8XzPdV1DzNzmL9***

title: Electronics & Control Panel Assembly Technician
description:
Electronics \& Control Panel Assembly Technician

**Company:** Carbelim Private Limited  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Department:** Production \& Manufacturing  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** On\-site  
**Reporting To:** Production Supervisor / Manufacturing Engineer

About Carbelim

Carbelim Private Limited is a climate\-tech company developing innovative microalgae\-powered solutions for air purification, carbon capture, clean\-air infrastructure, wastewater treatment, and sustainable urban development.

Our products integrate mechanical systems, electrical control panels, electronic components, sensors, IoT systems, LED assemblies, and automated monitoring technologies.

Position Overview

Carbelim is looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented **Electronics \& Control Panel Assembly Technician** to support its production and manufacturing operations.

The selected candidate will be responsible for assembling, wiring, soldering, testing, inspecting, and preparing electronic products, electrical control panels, PCB assemblies, LED systems, and associated components according to approved production drawings, wiring diagrams, standard operating procedures, and quality standards.

The candidate must be able to perform precise assembly work while maintaining product quality, electrical safety, workplace cleanliness, and production timelines.

Key ResponsibilitiesElectronic Assembly

* Assemble PCBs, electronic modules, sensors, controllers, and related components inside product enclosures.
* Mount electronic components according to approved assembly drawings and production instructions.
* Perform soldering, desoldering, wiring, crimping, and cable\-termination activities.
* Inspect solder joints, connectors, terminals, and electronic assemblies for proper workmanship.
* Assist with the integration of sensors, IoT modules, display units, and communication devices.
* Ensure that electronic components are handled according to electrostatic discharge safety procedures.

Control Panel Assembly

* Assemble and wire electrical and electronic control panels according to approved layouts and wiring diagrams.
* Mount and connect components such as:
* Switch\-mode power supplies
* Relays
* Contactors
* Circuit breakers
* Terminal blocks
* Controllers
* Communication modules
* Sensors
* Display units
* Electrical protection devices
* Prepare and install DIN rails, wiring ducts, terminal markers, labels, and panel accessories.
* Ensure that panel wiring is neat, properly routed, labelled, secured, and easy to maintain.
* Verify wire numbers, terminal connections, polarity, and component placement before testing.

Cable and Wiring Preparation

* Prepare cable harnesses according to approved production requirements.
* Perform wire cutting, stripping, crimping, ferruling, soldering, and termination.
* Install cable glands, connectors, sleeves, heat\-shrink tubes, and protective coverings.
* Apply appropriate cable labels and terminal identification.
* Maintain organised and professional cable\-management practices.
* Check cable continuity and connection accuracy before installation.

LED System Assembly

* Assemble LED strips, aluminium profiles, connectors, drivers, and diffusers.
* Cut and prepare LED strips according to product dimensions.
* Perform soldering and wiring of LED assemblies.
* Install LED profiles and lighting components neatly inside product structures.
* Test LED brightness, polarity, electrical connections, and functional performance.
* Identify and replace faulty LED strips, connectors, or power\-supply components.

Testing and Quality Inspection

* Perform basic electrical continuity, polarity, voltage, and functional testing.
* Use basic testing instruments such as:
* Digital multimeter
* Continuity tester
* Power supply
* Soldering station
* Wire and cable\-testing tools
* Conduct visual inspections to verify assembly quality and workmanship.
* Check products for loose connections, incorrect wiring, damaged components, and improper mounting.
* Support product testing and troubleshooting under the guidance of the production or engineering team.
* Record test results and communicate identified defects to the concerned supervisor.
* Carry out rework or corrective assembly activities when instructed.

Production and Documentation

* Follow approved assembly drawings, bill of materials, wiring diagrams, standard operating procedures, and production instructions.
* Complete assigned production activities within the planned timeline.
* Maintain production, testing, inspection, and material\-usage records.
* Report component shortages, damaged materials, assembly defects, and production delays immediately.
* Coordinate with production, electrical, electronics, mechanical, quality, and engineering teams.
* Support product packing and final preparation when required.
* Assist with prototype assembly and product\-development activities.

Safety and Workplace Management

* Follow all electrical, production, and workplace safety procedures.
* Maintain electrostatic discharge protection while handling sensitive electronic components.
* Use personal protective equipment wherever required.
* Keep tools, components, wires, workstations, and production areas clean and organised.
* Handle soldering equipment, electrical tools, and testing instruments safely.
* Avoid material wastage and ensure proper handling of company tools and equipment.
* Follow 5S and workplace housekeeping practices.

Required Qualifications

Candidates should possess one of the following qualifications:

* Diploma in Electronics and Communication Engineering
* Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
* Diploma in Mechatronics Engineering
* Diploma in Instrumentation and Control Engineering
* Diploma in Electrical Engineering
* ITI in Electronics Mechanic
* ITI in Electrician
* ITI in Wireman
* ITI in a related electrical or electronics discipline

Freshers with strong practical skills and relevant academic project experience may also apply.

Required Technical Skills

* Basic knowledge of electrical and electronic components.
* Good soldering and wiring skills.
* Ability to perform cable cutting, stripping, crimping, and ferruling.
* Ability to read basic wiring diagrams, assembly drawings, and electrical layouts.
* Basic knowledge of PCBs, relays, power supplies, terminal blocks, controllers, and sensors.
* Familiarity with hand tools, power tools, soldering stations, and assembly equipment.
* Basic knowledge of digital multimeter operation and continuity testing.
* Understanding of wire colour codes, polarity, and terminal identification.
* Ability to identify common electrical and electronic assembly defects.
* Good attention to detail and commitment to quality standards.

Preferred Skills

* Previous experience in electronic\-product assembly or control\-panel wiring.
* Experience assembling electrical panels, automation panels, IoT products, or sensor\-based systems.
* Familiarity with LED\-strip assembly and installation.
* Experience in PCB soldering and electronic\-component replacement.
* Knowledge of cable harness preparation and cable management.
* Basic troubleshooting knowledge.
* Understanding of electrostatic discharge practices.
* Familiarity with 5S, production safety, and quality\-control procedures.
* Ability to communicate in Tamil and understand basic technical instructions in English.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* Technically skilled and interested in hands\-on production work.
* Careful and accurate while assembling electrical and electronic components.
* Able to follow drawings, instructions, and standard operating procedures.
* Disciplined in maintaining quality and safety standards.
* Comfortable working with tools, wires, control panels, and electronic systems.
* Organised and capable of completing assigned tasks on time.
* Willing to learn new assembly methods, products, and technologies.
* Able to work independently as well as part of a production team.
* Responsible when handling tools, materials, and company equipment.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Assembly accuracy
* Wiring and soldering quality
* Product quality and workmanship
* Production efficiency
* Rework and rejection reduction
* Compliance with assembly drawings and procedures
* Proper use of materials and components
* Workplace safety compliance
* On\-time completion of assigned tasks
* Cleanliness and organisation of the workstation
* Accuracy of production and testing records

Important Transportation Requirement

**Public transportation is not readily available near the office location. Candidates must have their own reliable mode of transportation and should be able to commute to the workplace independently.**

Applicants are advised to review the office location and confirm their daily transportation arrangements before applying.

What Carbelim Offers

* Practical exposure to electronics and control\-panel manufacturing.
* Opportunity to work on innovative climate\-tech products.
* Experience in PCB assembly, sensors, IoT systems, LED products, and electrical panels.
* Training and guidance from production and engineering professionals.
* Exposure to prototype development and commercial product manufacturing.
* Professional growth opportunities based on performance, skills, and organisational requirements.

How to Apply

**hr@carbelim.in**

* Current location

title: IP Admin Senior Analyst
description:
We are looking for someone to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent \& Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent \& trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.
This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.


We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.

**Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2025\-2026 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

**It would be great if you also had . . .**

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

**What will you be doing in this role?**

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution

**About the Team**


The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.


Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.

**Hours of Work**

* You will be working for works 40 hours/week (8 hrs a day; 5 days a week); you are entitled to get Overtime if you work beyond your working hours.
* This is a permanent job role.

**Sales \& Marketing Executive (Digital Marketing \& Lead Generation)**  
Mathure Metal Works Pvt. Ltd. \| Thane East, Maharashtra \| Full\-Time, On\-Site

**About Us**

Mathure Metal Works Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's leading manufacturers of brazing alloys, soldering alloys, and fluxes, with over 50 years of expertise since 1972\. We supply industry leaders including Whirlpool, LG, Godrej, and Tata, and we export across various countries. We were the first company in India to introduce non\-CFC brazing products and have trained over 15,000 shop\-floor professionals nationwide.

As we modernise and scale, we are building a dedicated Sales \& Marketing function — and we're looking for the right person to lead that journey with us.

**Why This Role Is Special**

This is a build\-from\-scratch opportunity. You won't be one voice in a large team — you will BE the marketing function. You'll own our digital presence, build our lead\-generation engine, and shape how a respected 50\-year\-old brand shows up in the modern world. You'll work directly with the Director and have a clear path to a leadership role as we grow.

**The Role**

Your mission is simple: make quality clients find Mathure Metal Works online, build trust in our brand, and feed a healthy sales pipeline. The Director closes the deals — you generate and manage the opportunities.

Your time will be spent roughly as:

* Digital Marketing \& Brand Building (\~40%)
* Lead Generation \& Sales Support (\~30%)
* Online Presence \& B2B Portals (\~20%)
* Reporting, Analytics \& Coordination (\~10%)

**Key Responsibilities**

Digital Marketing \& Brand Building

* Build and manage our LinkedIn presence — publish 3 high\-quality posts per week
* Run a content calendar: technical education, company milestones, client stories, factory content, industry trends
* Write and publish 2 SEO\-focused blog articles per month
* Grow followers, engagement, and reach organically
* Create marketing visuals using tools like Canva

Lead Generation \& Sales Support

* Generate leads via LinkedIn outreach, cold email, and digital campaigns (HVAC, refrigeration, automotive)
* Respond to inbound enquiries within 2 hours and manage a disciplined pipeline
* Maintain a CRM / lead tracker so no lead is ever lost
* Prepare brochures, product catalogues, pitch decks, case studies, and quotation formats
* Qualify leads and hand sales\-ready opportunities to the Director

Online Presence \& B2B Portals

* Manage and improve website content — product pages, blog, landing pages
* Optimise B2B listings (IndiaMart, TradeIndia, ExportersIndia, export platforms)
* Set up and monitor Google Analytics and Search Console
* Manage a WhatsApp Business profile

Reporting \& Analytics

* Weekly performance report to the Director
* Monthly marketing report (LinkedIn growth, website traffic, enquiries, leads)
* Use data to recommend where to invest more

**What We're Looking For**

Must\-Have

* Graduate in any discipline (Marketing / Mass Comm / BMS / BBA a plus)
* 1–3 years in marketing, digital marketing, business development, or sales support (strong freshers with a portfolio welcome)
* Excellent written English
* Comfort with LinkedIn, MS Office, and Canva
* Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) for content and research
* A self\-starter with an ownership mindset
* Strong organisation and follow\-through
* Based in or able to commute to Thane East

Good\-to\-Have

* B2B, industrial, or manufacturing marketing experience
* Basic SEO and website tools (WordPress, Wix)
* Google Analytics and B2B portals (IndiaMart, TradeIndia)
* Lead generation, CRM, or email marketing tools
* Hindi and Marathi in addition to English

**What You'll Gain**

* Complete ownership of the marketing function
* Direct mentorship from the Director
* A clear growth path to Marketing Manager and beyond
* Represent a 50\-year legacy brand with Fortune\-500 clients
* Performance incentives with a 6\-month review
* A genuine learning culture

**Compensation**

INR 2\.5 – 3\.5 LPA (based on experience) \+ performance incentives.

**How to Apply**

Apply directly through this posting, or email your CV to aum@mathuremetalworks.com with the subject line "Application – Sales \& Marketing Executive." A short note on why you're interested — and a link to any content, page, or portfolio you've built — will help your application stand out. We care about what you can build, not just your years of experience.
