title: Business Analyst -Credit Risk
description:
PAYU PAYMENTS PRIVATE LIMITED
   

  

**Job Details**
**Position Title**
 BA\-Credit Risk
   

  

**Company**
 PayU Finance
   

  

 Location:
   

  

 Gurgaon (preferable)
   

  

**About Us**
 PayU Finance stands as the premier credit and lending division of the PayU brand, a wholly\-owned subsidiary of the globally renowned Prosus group (formerly Naspers group) headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands. With an impressive track record of disbursing over $280 million in consumer credit and approximately 20 billion loans by volume, we have established ourselves as a market leader in financial technology innovation. PayU Finance provides consumers and merchants with easy access to affordable short\-term/medium\-term loans.
   

  

**About Role**
 This pivotal position sits at the intersection of innovation and expansion within our embedded merchant lending division at PayU Finance. As a key contributor, you will be instrumental in our "0 to 1" scaling journey, where your expertise will drive the transformation of how we leverage both alternative and traditional data sources to extend credit to underserved/new market segments. Your impact will be realized through the strategic application of advanced analytics, cutting\-edge data science methodologies, and deep domain knowledge.
   

  

**Role Details**
* Develop and implement credit risk management strategies ensuring lending activities are prudent, profitable, and compliant with regulations
* Design credit policies using traditional and alternative data sources to optimize risk\-adjusted returns while meeting business objectives
* Partner with senior leadership and partners to establish scalable risk frameworks that support our hyper\-growth trajectory
* Establish and refine acquisition and customer management strategies specifically tailored for our merchant lending business
* Collaborate across Business, Data Science, Product, and Technology teams to create customer\-centric solutions that enable prudent scaling
* Work directly with C\-suite executives to ensure appropriate risk strategies are implemented throughout the organization
* Champion a culture of proactive risk management that supports our mission


**Candidate Profile**
**Educational Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
   

  

**Experience**
* 1\-2 years of Experience in Credit Risk Policy / Risk Analytics OR
* 1\-2 years of Experience in Business Analytics/Business Strategy


**Skills Required**
* Strong problem\-solving abilities with strong communication and stakeholder management skills to successfully deliver business and risk initiatives
* Proficiency in at least one technical language (R, SAS, Python, or SQL)
* Demonstrated ability to visualize complex data analyses and communicate insights effectively to diverse audiences, including executive leadership
* Strong sense of ownership with proven track record of delivering results\-focused projects

For instance, you could use Azure SQL Database or Azure Cosmos DB for structured data, Azure Data Lake Storage for big data and unstructured data, or Azure Blob Storage for file storage. • Data Warehousing: Implementing data warehousing solutions is a common use case for Azure Data Engineers. Azure Synapse Analytics (formerly Azure SQL Data Warehouse) offers scalable and distributed analytics capabilities for handling large datasets. • Data Modeling and Analysis: Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to design and implement data models for analytical workloads. Azure Analysis Services or Azure Databricks can be used for building and deploying models to support interactive data analysis.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.
   

  

**Meet the Team**
 The DSE Platform Independent Common (PI\-Common) group develops high\-performance, platform\-independent system software that runs across Cisco’s flagship routers and switches. We design and deliver core routing protocols and infrastructure components that power Cisco’s Mass Scale Infrastructure, Cloud Networking, and Network Experience portfolios.
   

  

 Our team works on key control\-plane technologies including IGP routing protocols such as OSPF, IS\-IS, EIGRP and RIP, BGP\-LS, First Hop Redundancy Protocols such as HSRP, VRRP and GLBP, and routing infrastructure components such as route\-policy frameworks, prefix handling, filtering, and control\-plane scalability mechanisms.
   

  

 These components form the foundation of networking deployments across enterprise, service provider, cloud, and AI infrastructure environments, where scale, resiliency, security, programmability, and operational debuggability are critical.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Software Engineer in PI\-Common, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of routing protocol and routing infrastructure software used across Cisco platforms. You will work with senior engineers to build reliable, scalable, and debuggable control\-plane software. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

 Developing features, enhancements, and defect fixes for IGP protocols, BGP\-LS, FHRP technologies, and routing infrastructure components.
   

  

 Writing clean, efficient, maintainable code in C/C\+\+ for multi\-threaded, system\-level software environments.
   

  

 Contributing to routing infrastructure components such as route\-policy handling, filtering, prefix processing, and control\-plane integration modules.
   

  

 Debugging software issues using logs, traces, core files, protocol state, and platform\-level diagnostics.
   

  

 Participating in root cause analysis for defects and customer\-found issues, with guidance from senior engineers.
   

  

 Building unit, functional, regression, and scale validation coverage for protocol and infrastructure changes.
   

  

 Working closely with platform, hardware, and test teams to validate software behavior across Cisco operating systems and platforms.
   

  

 Learning protocol behavior, implementation details, and operational aspects of production routing systems.
   

  

 Participating in design discussions, code reviews, and technical reviews to build strong engineering judgment.
   

  

 Contributing to team quality, automation, debuggability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications Required**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Networking, or a related technical field.
* 1\-3 years of relevant software development experience.
* Strong understanding of data structures, operating systems, and computer networking fundamentals.
* Programming experience in C or C\+\+.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or Perl.
* Familiarity with Unix/Linux development environments.
* Good problem\-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.


**Preferred Qualifications Good To Have**
 Exposure to routing protocols such as OSPF, IS\-IS, EIGRP, RIP, BGP, or BGP\-LS.
   

  

 Understanding of multi\-threaded programming, IPC, memory management, or system\-level software concepts.
   

  

 Familiarity with debugging tools such as gdb, logs, packet captures, traces, or core\-file analysis.
   

  

 Exposure to networking software, embedded systems, distributed systems, or large\-scale infrastructure software.
   

  

 Ability to learn complex technical areas quickly and work well in a team environment.
   

  

 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
   

  

 WeAreCisco
   

  

 \#WeAreCisco where every individual brings their unique skills and perspectives together to pursue our purpose of powering an inclusive future for all.
   

  

 Our passion is connection. We celebrate our employees’ diverse set of backgrounds and focus on unlocking potential. Cisconians often experience one company, many careers where learning and development are encouraged and supported at every stage.
   

  

 Our purpose, driven by our people, is what makes us the worldwide leader in technology that powers the internet. Helping our customers reimagine their applications, secure their enterprise, transform their infrastructure, and meet their sustainability goals is what we do best. Take your next step and be you, with us.
   

  

 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 🏢 About Avua \& HR\-Tech Innovation
   

  

 Avua is a pioneering technology enterprise specializing in SaaS\-based recruiting solutions, artificial intelligence integrations, and predictive hiring pipelines. Incorporated as a premium talent acquisition innovator, Avua utilizes deep neural networks, natural language processing (NLP), and cloud\-native assessment environments to simplify recruitment pathways worldwide. Its primary platform transforms historical resume filtering by establishing semantic context matching, replacing traditional keyword searches with intent\-driven talent discovery.
   

  

 Operating on a global remote framework, Avua serves fast\-scaling enterprises and Fortune 500 corporations in the US, Europe, and India. The platform is continuously refined by a high\-caliber distributed engineering team that deploys real\-time analytics engines, career visualization algorithms, automated salary benchmarking interfaces, and interactive ATS integration middleware. Joining Avua means becoming a part of a specialized, high\-growth environment dedicated to reshaping the global future of work.
   

  

 ⭐ 4\.2/5 on Glassdoor 👨‍💻 100\-500 Global Talents 🚀 Leading AI\-Driven Recruiter
   

  

 📝 Official Designation
   

  

 Junior Software Developer
   

  

 💰 Estimated Compensation
   

  

 ₹6\+ LPA (Est. Base Range)
   

  

 🕒 Location \& Program
   

  

 Remote (Work From Home) \| Full\-time
   

  

 🌟 Role Significance \& Engineering Growth
   

  

 Stepping into Avua as a Junior Software Developer is distinct from conventional services\-oriented training roles. In classical enterprise frameworks, junior coders are often isolated to repetitive maintenance or test case scripting. At Avua, you enter a collaborative, product\-first SaaS environment where you work directly on production\-level platforms. Under the guidance of seasoned principal engineers, you will contribute directly to microservices development, performance profiling, and web app modules used daily by recruiters and global candidates.
   

  

 Our engineering team operates on a highly decentralized, remote\-first setup. This structure requires and builds strong operational discipline, proactive asynchronous communication skills, and complete ownership of assigned Git branches. Junior engineers are supported through 1:1 mentorship loops, collaborative pair programming, and modular system reviews. This systematic foundation accelerates your progress from writing functional components to architecting complex, scalable software modules.
   

  

 ✅ Eligibility Criteria
   

  

* Educational Background: Currently pursuing or completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative technical field.
* Batch Eligibility: Ideally structured for the 2024, 2025, and 2026 graduating cohorts, including ambitious 2027 graduates seeking immediate technical transitions.
* Foundational Programming: Strong foundational command of at least one general\-purpose programming language, with priority on JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C\+\+, or Java.
* Object\-Oriented Concepts: Thorough understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) architectures, software life cycles, and solid modular design practices.
* Modern Tech Stack Familiarity: Basic exposure to web frameworks like React.js, Angular, Node.js, Spring Boot, or Django is highly advantageous.
* Collaboration \& Git: Solid understanding of code versioning standards, branching strategies, and collaborative code reviews using Git/GitHub.
* Analytic Mindset: Exceptional debugging capabilities, logical problem\-solving skills, and a strong self\-driven workflow suitable for remote environments.


 📝 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* App Development \& Maintenance: Assist in the conceptualization, design, development, unit testing, and maintenance of Avua’s core recruitment\-focused web and mobile interfaces.
* Clean Code Delivery: Write clean, logical, documented, and performance\-optimized code following standard architectural guidelines under the guidance of tech leads.
* Collaborate and Solve: Team up with cross\-functional product departments including QA, UI/UX, and product managers to split complex features into modular, shippable units.

description:
**About Us:**
 Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.
   

  

 Seismic is the global leader in AI\-powered enablement, empowering go\-to\-market leaders to drive strategic growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences at scale. The Seismic Enablement Cloud™ is the only unified AI\-powered platform that prepares customer\-facing teams with the skills, content, tools, and insights needed to maximize every buyer interaction and strengthen client relationships. Trusted by more than 2,000 organizations worldwide, Seismic helps businesses achieve measurable outcomes and accelerate revenue growth. Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. Learn more at seismic.com.
   

  

**Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.**
**Overview:**
**Seismic AI:**
 AI is one of the fastest growing product areas in Seismic. We believe that AI, particularly Generative AI, will empower and transform how Enterprise sales and marketing organizations operate and interact with customers. Seismic Aura, our leading AI engine, is powering this change in the sales enablement space and is being infused across the Seismic enablement cloud. Our focus is to leverage AI across the Seismic platform to make our customers more productive and efficient in their day\-to\-day tasks, and to drive more successful sales outcomes.
   

  

**Who you are:**
**Experience:**
* 1\+ years of experience in software engineering, with experience contributing to frontend or UI\-focused web applications.


**Technical Expertise:**
* Full\-stack experience (C\#, Node.js, Python)
* Experience with HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Experience building user interfaces using React, including functional components, hooks, and state management patterns.
* Experience with TypeScript, including writing strongly typed components and APIs.
* Familiarity with modern CSS techniques such as CSS Modules, styled\-components, Tailwind, or similar approaches.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with REST or GraphQL APIs.
* Working knowledge of automated frontend testing practices (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright).
* Experience using Git for source control and collaborating through pull requests.
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and modern frontend pipelines, including GitHub Actions.
* Exposure to frontend performance optimization techniques (code splitting, lazy loading, memoization).
* Exposure to accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practices is a plus.
* Exposure to design systems or component libraries is a plus.


**Cloud Expertise:**
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure.
* Basic familiarity with cloud\-native services for data storage, compute, and monitoring.
* Experience deploying or supporting containerized applications in Kubernetes is a plus.


**Good to have: Search/retrieval/AI:**
* Interest or exposure to search or information retrieval systems.
* RAG/generative AI, conversational AI, agents, LLMs.
* Familiarity with search platforms such as Elasticsearch, Apache Solr, or similar is a plus.
* Basic understanding of text processing, semantic search, or AI\-driven features is beneficial.


**SaaS Knowledge:** 
 Experience working on SaaS applications or cloud\-hosted services. Understanding of standard concepts related to modern distributed systems and cloud operations.
   

  

**Product Development:** 
 Experience collaborating with product management and design to implement well\-defined requirements. Ability to translate clear business and technical requirements into working software. Contribute to feature development within a defined scope.
   

  

* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with teams across different regions.
* Willingness to collaborate with the China team and participate in cross\-timezone work as needed.
* Scrum and JIRA experience a plus.


**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

**Fast\-paced Environment:** 
 Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, preferably in a SaaS or technology\-driven company.
   

  

**What you’ll be doing:**
**As a Software Engineer I** 
 for our
 **Agentic AI Interfaces** 
 team, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of backend systems that power our web application, including search, content discovery, and AI capabilities. You will work closely with senior engineers and cross\-functional partners to build reliable, scalable systems that deliver value to our customers while continuing to grow your technical expertise.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Distributed Systems Development: Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of backend systems and services supporting search functionality, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Search \& Algorithm Support: Assist in implementing search and/or AI\-related features, including indexing, retrieval, and ranking logic, to improve search accuracy and efficiency.
* Integration: Collaborate with engineers, AI partners, and product teams to integrate search and AI\-driven capabilities across the Seismic platform.
* Performance Tuning: Participate in monitoring and performance tuning efforts, identifying routine bottlenecks and applying guided improvements to ensure acceptable query latency.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams, including product managers, frontend engineers, and UX designers, to support seamless search experiences.
* Continuous Improvement: Learn and apply new tools, technologies, and best practices related to search, backend development, and AI systems.


**What we have for you:**
 At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
   

  

 Headquartered in San Diego and with employees across the globe, Seismic is the global leader in sales
 **enablement** 
 , backed by firms such as Permira, Ameriprise Financial, EDBI, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and T. Rowe Price. Seismic also expanded its team and product portfolio with the strategic acquisitions of SAVO, Percolate, Grapevine6, and Lessonly. Our board of directors is composed of several industry luminaries including John Thompson, former Chairman of the Board for Microsoft.
   

  

 Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.

description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays.
   

  

 The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

 The Global Service Support Organization (GSS) team headquartered in Milpitas, CA, is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The GSS organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts.
   

  

 The GSS organization's Engineering group develops data systems for improved diagnostics and predictive maintenance. The data systems monitor the performance of fleets of KLA test and measurement equipment in semiconductor fabrication plant environments. They collect, transform, and store data. They provide visualizations, recommendations based on analytics, and alerts. This exciting position will enable you to interact with a wide variety of engineers and KLA system data.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

  

 Do you have a passion for coding, data exploration, and UI design? Are you looking for a role where you can develop reactive, modern user interfaces working with highly collaborative teams?
   

  

 As a Software engineer, you will work with our team of software, data and algorithm engineers on the design and development of web applications using real\-time data visualization tools. Collaborating with domain experts and software engineers, you will gather requirements, translate user needs to design and develop software specifications, select software components, follow best coding practices, and develop User Interfaces that help our engineers to more effectively monitor, diagnose and optimize KLA semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment.

* Experience working in a service\-oriented or microservice architecture

 🏢 About Ecolab \& Global Digital Innovation
   

  

 Ecolab is a global sustainability titan trusted by millions across more than 170 countries. As the undisputed world leader in water management, hygiene services, and infection prevention solutions, Ecolab helps secure clean water, safe food, and abundant energy. Beyond physical operations, Ecolab leverages cutting\-edge technology as a critical business driver. Its specialized engineering teams build next\-generation cloud architectures, real\-time IoT diagnostic pipelines, predictive asset management models, and heavy data systems that monitor thousands of industrial operations worldwide.
   

  

 The Ecolab Digital Center (EDC) in Bengaluru, India, serves as the primary strategic global technology accelerator driving software innovation across the parent company's commercialized portfolio. At the EDC, engineering teams scale robust SaaS platforms that capture sensor data from heavy machinery, optimize sanitization schedules for hospitals, and run advanced machine\-learning simulations to minimize energy consumption. Operating in a progressive, collaborative workplace culture, the center supports continuous learning and offers engineers a direct pathway to design complex enterprise products that positively impact global human health and environmental preservation.
   

  

 ⭐ 3\.9/5 on Glassdoor 👨‍💻 45,000\+ Global Employees 🚀 World Leader in Sustainability
   

  

 📝 Official Designation
   

  

 Associate Software Engineer
   

  

 💰 Estimated Compensation
   

  

 ₹10\+ LPA (Est. Base Range)
   

  

 🕒 Location \& Program
   

  

 Bengaluru \| Hybrid Office
   

  

 🌟 Entry\-Level Impact \& Engineering Learning Curve
   

  

 Joining Ecolab as an Associate Software Engineer is an immersive learning experience designed for high\-potential engineering graduates. In traditional corporate software setups, early\-career engineers are often assigned isolated, non\-critical sub\-tasks or general manual data entry. At Ecolab, you enter as a fully functional contributor, integrated directly into product development teams. Under the guidance of experienced tech leads and principal architects, you will participate in designing clean, scalable code modules that meet international regulatory and safety standards.
   

  

 The primary objective of this role is to establish your fundamental technical framework, converting theoretical CS knowledge into production\-ready software systems. Associate engineers are supported by structured 1:1 mentoring pathways, learning sessions with architects in higher grades, and complete exposure to robust Agile development cycles. Over time, you will learn to navigate complex microservice designs, clean testing methods, and automated CI/CD deployments, rapidly preparing you to take complete ownership of critical system structures.
   

  

 ✅ Eligibility Criteria
   

  

* Educational Background: Currently pursuing or completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a quantitative mathematical field of study.
* Batch Eligibility: Specifically structured for the 2024, 2025, and 2026 graduating cohorts. Ambitious 2027 graduates available for immediate full\-time transitions are welcome.
* Professional Experience: 0 to 2 years of active development experience. Alternatively, candidates with 4–6 years of equivalent combined tech\-education and hands\-on project work are fully eligible.
* Languages of Choice: Foundational grasp of at least one general\-purpose programming language, with target priorities on Java, Python, C\#, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Core Foundations: Clear, strong comprehension of basic Data Structures, Algorithms (DSA), and Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) architectures.
* Collaborative Tooling: Basic knowledge of code repositories, version control protocols, and branching structures using Git or GitHub.
* Analytic Mindset: Eagerness to absorb modern engineering patterns, outstanding debugging capabilities, and excellent verbal and written communication skills.


 📝 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Feature Development: Write, modify, document, and test clean application code that directly meets specific commercialized project requirements and system standards.
* Documentation Support: Assist senior developers in drafting comprehensive software design specifications, API structures, and platform architecture flowcharts.
* QA \& Debugging: Collaborate actively with testing and QA engineering departments to reproduce, investigate, and correct software bugs and system bottlenecks.
* Continuous Learning: Participate in structural team meetings and code reviews to learn technical standards and strategies implemented by senior engineers.
* Agile Alignment: Participate in Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and asynchronous communication updates to support clean, on\-time project iterations.
* Security \& Quality Metrics: Write robust, secure code under the supervision of your security manager, helping secure private industrial data modules.


 💻 Industrial IoT \& Sustainability Horizons (2026\-2027\)
   

  

 The convergence of sustainability goals with digital system design is driving a major transformation across industrial tech ecosystems. Modern resource\-management platforms are no longer static databases; they are reactive ecosystems operating on high\-velocity data streaming channels. Millions of connected sensors on factory floors, water purification systems, and hospital ventilation networks send real\-time streams that must be parsed instantly to identify errors, prevent wastage, and avoid hardware failures.
   

  

 As we approach 2027, software engineering is heavily centered on optimizing this "Edge\-to\-Cloud" data path. Junior developers entering this ecosystem are expected to write highly efficient backend logic in Java/Spring Boot or Node.js, run optimized relational database commands, and build secure API architectures. Learning to deploy microservices within isolated container structures like Docker, while optimizing for low memory consumption, ensures that engineers can scale software platforms to meet modern industrial needs.
   

  

 🧠 Recommended Tech Skills Mapping
   

  

 Java / Spring Boot C\# .NET \& Web API JavaScript / TypeScript Data Structures \& OOP SQL (PostgreSQL / MSSQL) Git Branching \& Workflows Cloud \& IoT Architecture (Intro)
   

  

 🎯 Ecolab Technical Selection Pipeline
   

  

* Resume Screening \& Core Filter


 Candidates are initially filtered based on academic background, programming projects, and clear documentation. Highlighting clean OOP concepts or complete full\-stack web projects inside your resume accelerates initial callback rates.
   

  

* Online Technical Assessment (OA)


 A timed platform challenge featuring analytical aptitude tasks, fundamental software logic questions, core coding snippets (Java/Python/C\#), and standard SQL join scenarios.
   

  

* Live Technical \& Database Evaluation


 An interactive live session with Ecolab senior developers focusing on basic database normalization, OOP architecture patterns, debugging steps, and algorithmic complexity checks.
   

  

* Managerial Fitment \& Project Synergy


 A conversation focusing on project team coordination, enthusiasm to learn unfamiliar tech stacks, operational safety guidelines, and cultural fit within Ecolab's decentralized workspace.
   

  

 🚀 Boost Your Placement Preparation
   

  

 📝 Practice Our Placement Test Simulator

 💼 StudyEcart Premium Java Full\-Stack Developer Program
   

  

 Master complex back\-end architectures, microservices optimization, Spring framework, database systems, and interactive UI frameworks. Join our curated professional cohort designed specifically to land premium technology offers.
   

  

 💡 Ecolab Tech Interview Key Tips
   

  

**🔥 Core Topics To Master Before Your Call**
* Relational Logic \& Schemas: Normalizing database tables, standard constraints, and query optimization patterns.
* Object\-Oriented Design: Be prepared to explain and write code showing Polymorphism, Inheritance, Encapsulation, and Interface Abstraction.
* Software Testing Basics: Unit testing techniques, integration tests, and the standard life cycle of bug resolution.


 🧾 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
   

  

 Q: Are graduates of the 2024 and 2025 batches eligible to apply?
   

  

 A: Yes. This Associate role is designed for entry\-level candidates with less than 2 years of experience, making recent graduates highly eligible.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for SW Test engineers who wish to be a part of developing and evolving the current and next generation of routers that form the core of anything internet. These routers are at the heart of Nokia’s IP product offerings, from data centers (including AI fabrics), to providing strong, resilient low latency and dependable IP backhaul for service providers and mission critical networks. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with one of the best engineering teams in the industry. We value your expertise and offer an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. There are more customers we want to win, more networks to penetrate, more technologies to enable and more applications to support. We want to make smaller products, and we want to make bigger products. We want to build products based on newer standards and newer ASICS in the market.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Own software features end to end and ensure their quality is robust across products and platforms
* Specialize in datacenter and AI networks
* Write modular, lean, and efficient automation code including libraries and infrastructure
* Work closely with product management and software developers to meet customer requirements


**Key Skills And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree with 3–8 years of relevant experience in networking and software automation.
* Exposure to any of the below domains:
+ Layer\-2 switching and layer\-3 routing
+ Routing protocols (ospf, isis, bgp)
+ Multicast (pim, igmp)
+ Segment Routing
+ Mpls (ldp, rsvp\-te)
+ Evpns with vxlan, mpls, sr\-te underlays
+ QoS (policers, schedulers, shapers)

* Automation experience in python, golang or any programming language
* Experience in virtualized environments such as kvm, dockers, and Kubernetes
* Contribution to SONiC test infrastructure and automation frameworks
* Good communication skills to work with different engineering teams
* Proven aptitude for methodical problem solving, good communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work well in a close\-knit team.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**
 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* Flexible and hybrid working schemes
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave, with the option to return to work within a year following the birth or adoption of a child (based on eligibility)
* Life insurance to all employees to provide peace of mind and financial security
* Well\-being programs to support your mental and physical health
* Opportunities to join and receive support from Nokia Employee Resource Groups (NERGs)
* Employee Growth Solutions to support your personalized career \& skills development
* Diverse pool of Coaches \& Mentors to whom you have easy access
* A learning environment which promotes personal growth and professional development \- for your role and beyond

While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

Job Description: Physiotherapist

**Physiotherapist**

Department

Physiotherapy \& Rehabilitation

Qualification

* Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) from a recognized institution.
* Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) is preferred.
* Valid registration with the respective State Physiotherapy Council or other applicable regulatory authority, where required.

Experience

* Minimum 1 year of experience as a Physiotherapist in a hospital, rehabilitation center, or healthcare facility.
* Freshers with relevant clinical internship experience may be considered.

Key Responsibilities

* Assess patients' physical conditions and develop individualized physiotherapy treatment plans.
* Provide physiotherapy interventions for orthopedic, neurological, cardiopulmonary, pediatric, geriatric, and post\-operative patients, as applicable.
* Perform therapeutic exercises, manual therapy, electrotherapy, and other evidence\-based physiotherapy techniques.
* Monitor patient progress and modify treatment plans based on clinical outcomes.
* Educate patients and caregivers on home exercise programs, posture correction, mobility, and injury prevention.
* Maintain accurate assessment findings, treatment records, progress notes, and discharge summaries.
* Coordinate with consultants, nursing staff, and other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive patient care.
* Ensure proper use, maintenance, and safe handling of physiotherapy equipment.
* Follow infection prevention and control practices and comply with hospital safety policies.
* Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings, clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, and continuing professional education.
* Promote patient safety, confidentiality, and ethical standards in all aspects of care.

Required Skills

* Sound knowledge of anatomy, physiology, biomechanics, and rehabilitation principles.
* Ability to assess, diagnose, and manage a wide range of musculoskeletal, neurological, and cardiopulmonary conditions.
* Proficiency in therapeutic exercise techniques, manual therapy, and electrotherapy modalities.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and patient counseling skills.
* Good documentation and clinical decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multidisciplinary healthcare team.

Working Conditions

* Rotational shifts as per hospital requirements.
* Availability to provide emergency or weekend rehabilitation services when required.

* Compassionate and patient\-centered approach.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Commitment to evidence\-based practice, continuous learning, and quality improvement.
* Professional attitude with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary healthcare environment.

Department

WE ARE HIRING Floor Manager – Textiles Location: Fiow Wedding Centre, Oachira Key Responsibilities: Supervise the daily operations of the showroom floor. Lead and motivate the sales team to achieve targets. Ensure excellent customer service and resolve customer concerns. Monitor product display, merchandising, and stock availability. Train, guide, and evaluate staff performance. Maintain cleanliness, discipline, and visual standards of the showroom. Coordinate with the warehouse and billing teams for smooth operations. Prepare daily sales and operational reports. Requirements: Minimum 2–5 years of experience in textile retail, preferably in a supervisory or managerial role. Strong leadership and communication skills. Ability to manage a team and work under pressure. Good knowledge of textile products and retail operations. Computer knowledge is an added advantage. Salary: Attractive package based on experience. Interested candidates can apply by sending their CV or contacting the HR Department.

Send cv to : 9745428883

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(****Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
